name: Becoming a Parent
objectiveText: Speak to Agnar Beastamer in the Hinterlands.

comments.body: The first person you talk to is in Feralas.  Look up the quest freedom for all creatures.  After you do that quest talk to the NPC next to the one that gave you the freedom for all creatures quest.  Do her series which finally ends in Darnassus.  When your done with that head all the way back to feralas and back to the original NPC.  he'll send you to Quinten in 1000 needles.  do his quest series and you'll finally end up with the pet.  its about 8 or 10 quests in total
At level 49 this quest yields 440 XP and gives a slight increase to Darnassus and Wildhammer Clan reputations.

Very cute, tiny little faerie dragon... thing is a total chick-magnet too.  :p

This series was very fun and also pretty hard.  Those damn stealthed wolves gave us fits.

-Panoramix

This quest series begins with an elf in Azshara at (65, 45). 

Freedom for All Creatures, Free 6 sprites 

Doling Justice (part 1) Kill the Taurens 

Doling Justice (part 2) Go to Darnassus 

An Orphan Looking For A Home, Come back to the Elf in Azshara to get this quest, go to Thousand Needles 

A Short Incubation, Bring 2 Elixir of Fortitudes 

The Newest Member of the Family, Go to Hinterlands in less than one hour 

Food for Baby, Get 5 Silvermane Stalker Flank 

Becoming A Parent, Get your Sprite Darter Egg!
replies:
Girder, your information is very good except for one key point... You go to FERALAS [b]NOT[/b] Azshara.

TWO SETS OF QUESTS

Once you have done the timed one and so on, and got your reward in Darnassus Temple of the Moon, it ENDS!

YOU MUST GO BACK to feralis to get the SECOND SET OF QUESTS.

afk to do a tiny bit of research.. brb :D

First of all you start in Feralas by doing the "Freedom for all creatures" series, when she after that sends you to Tyrande, go there, and then return to Feralas and talk to the one where it all started. Instructions from there is easy enough for anyone to follow. (Yes that means they tell you EXACTLY how to do, dont worry your little heads, you dont need to think at all)

comments.body:
If for any reason you should lose possession of this pet, you will not be able to get it back (unless you can still buy it back from the vendor).

In my haste, I confused my pet with the [url=/item=11419]Mysterious Unhatched Egg[/url] that was also in my inventory, and sold the former instead of the latter shortly before logging.

When I came back on, I found that upon attempting to release my pet, it was not in my inventory. That unhatched egg still was.

Just a warning.

I started this quest as a lvl 44.  I needed 12,000 more xp points to make lvl 45.  I did the entire chain of quests in about 2-3 hours.

Once I was finished I was a lvl 45 and had 34,000 points.  So I gained roughly 46,000 xp points during the entire chain. That was all the quest turn-in's and the killing xp.  

In case you can't find Kindall.  Look for the cage of sprite darters.  She is directly behind it on a little cliff.  Water separates her from the cage.  To the left of the cage there is a tree with a very tiny path up this hill.  Take that.  It will go UP then down to these two women. 

ENJOY THE PET!

Xaria
